description:
A couple of days ago I spent a few days surfing at Kovalam Beach in South India near Trivandrum. They have some decent waves and there is an artificial reef that really goes off when the swell is big enough. I filmed this video with a GoPro using the suction mount - it worked surprisingly well and never came off.

Learn more about my tips for India travel at http://www.asherfergusson.com

Cheers,

Asher.
